steps.caption: The price book
steps.narration: This is your price book. It's the price list your estimates pick from.

steps.caption: Four tabs
steps.narration: It has four tabs: Price Chart, Materials, Labor and Formulas.

steps.caption: A SKU: name, code, unit, description
steps.narration: Price Chart lists what you sell. Each item has a name, a code, a unit and a description.

steps.caption: Add SKU and From template
steps.narration: Add SKU and From template bring in new items.

steps.caption: Search by name or code
steps.narration: To find an item, search by name or code.

steps.caption: Type a quantity
steps.narration: To check a price, type a quantity. Here it's one hundred twenty feet of baseboard.

steps.caption: Material, labor, total
steps.narration: The item expands into its material and its labor, with waste added, and a total.

steps.caption: Cost and margin
steps.narration: The last line shows your cost and your margin.

steps.caption: Materials
steps.narration: Materials holds what you buy, with your cost, your price and a waste percent.

steps.caption: Margin per material
steps.narration: Each row works out the margin for you.

steps.caption: Labor
steps.narration: Labor holds your hourly rates. Cost is what you pay, and price is what you charge.

steps.caption: The default rate
steps.narration: One rate is marked as the default.

steps.caption: Formulas
steps.narration: Formulas is a tester. It shows what a quantity formula works out to.

steps.caption: Test
steps.narration: Fill in the values and choose Test to see the answer.

steps.caption: The answer
steps.narration: Thirty-two squares with ten percent waste comes to thirty-six.

steps.caption: Menu: Price book
steps.narration: You'll find Price book in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: Tour the price book: items, materials, labor | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short tour of the price book in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see the four tabs - Price Chart, Materials, Labor and Formulas - search for an item, and preview a quantity to see its material, labor, total, cost and margin.
